<DESCRIPTION>
Starts cooperatively to earn mutual-cooperation payoff, retaliates after exploitation, and returns to cooperation after sustained opponent cooperation. This should outperform unconditional defection across mixed repeated-game opponents while remaining robust to defectors.
</DESCRIPTION>

<CODE>
```python
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def policy(own_history, opponent_history):
    return 0 if not opponent_history else (1 if opponent_history[-1] == 1 else 0)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
```
